## Architecture Overview

The `DB.Querier` method in `prometheus/tsdb/db.go` has signature `Querier(mint, maxt int64) (storage.Querier, error)`. Adding a context parameter breaks all callers including the PromQL engine, API handlers, rules evaluation, Thanos sidecar store, and Mimir ingester.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Definition

- **`tsdb/db.go`** (lines 273, 658, 2248, 2402) — DB struct and Querier method definitions.
- **`tsdb/querier.go`** — blockQuerier implementation of storage.Querier.

### Prometheus Callers

- **`promql/engine.go`** (line 760) — `queryable.Querier(mint, maxt)` call. KEY CALLER.
- **`web/api/v1/api.go`** (lines 776, 864, 979) — API handler calls.
- **`rules/group.go`** (line 750) — `g.opts.Queryable.Querier(mintMS, maxtMS)` call.
- **`storage/fanout.go`** — Fanout storage implementation.
- **`storage/remote/storage.go`** — Remote storage.

### Thanos (Sidecar)

- **`pkg/store/tsdb.go`** (lines 275, 394, 453) — `s.db.ChunkQuerier(minTime, maxTime)` calls. Thanos sidecar wraps TSDB.
- **`pkg/receive/multitsdb.go`** (lines 766-770) — BlockChunkQuerierFunc definition.

### Mimir (Ingester)

- **`pkg/ingester/user_tsdb.go`** (lines 198-208) — `userTSDB.Querier(mint, maxt)` delegates to db.Querier().
- **`pkg/ingester/ingester.go`** — Main ingester using Querier interface.
- **`pkg/querier/blocks_store_queryable.go`** — Blocks storage queryable.
